title: Updating the scratch copy
statement: For any register state and any natural number $z$, replacing its scratch-copy field $tmp$ by $z$ gives a register-value vector equal to the vector obtained by replacing coordinate $6$ of the original vector by $z$.
replaced:
For a register state with register-value vector $v$, replacing the value of register $6$
by $z$ gives the same vector as updating its $6$th coordinate to $z$.
